rows.what: qip_kernel::mismatch routes each fused mismatch to one paper-only record. Investigations and challenges are research-loop candidates (bounded at MAX_MISMATCH_CANDIDATES=16, provisional, drops counted) charged to the acquisition budget by launch_ranked.
